title: SpinUntil's loop advance is inverted into a non-terminating spin
synthetic_rationale: Exercises the runner's timeout path with a bounded, allocation-free non-terminating loop: costs CPU only for the duration of this record's own short timeout_seconds, never memory, so it is safe to run on a developer machine. Not a per-head query mutation.
notes: timeout_seconds is deliberately short (3s, not the usual 15s) so this record's own control case runs quickly; the mutated loop never allocates, so it cannot trip the memory bound before the wall-clock ceiling does.
